description:
Use this when the user wants the bell cleared: "mark my notifications read", "I've seen those", "clear the
        unread count". Marks notifications read; it deletes none. ids: the ids of the notifications from
        list_notifications; leave it empty to mark every notification read. An unknown id is skipped, and ids that
        match nothing are refused.
        Not for: reading them (list_notifications). Free: no Horizon Units. Changes only the read marks, and the user
        can still see every notification in RipClip.
name: mark_notifications_read
title: Mark notifications read
